steps.name: Epilogue ~ A Tale of Comfort
steps.objective: Listen to the visitor who came to see [Medea].

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This powerful presence approaching the barrier... Even stronger than %s's...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I expected you to amuse yourself with the barrier for a while, but apparently not today. You...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I just wanted to talk. It's been so long since I came inside. Did this place always look like this...? My memory's fuzzy♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're smiling, but you look dreadful. You seem to need some comfort.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We may be called Champions, but in the face of pain and grief, we are merely frail humans whom even the gods cannot help...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I was thinking while I made Edda's gravestone... I just couldn't bear it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic understands me well, but I couldn't tell him everything in my heart...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought I'd put it all behind me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So I was the person you wanted to talk to.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well, there's a middle-aged man and an old lizard nearby, but I didn't feel like talking to them.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: How rude of you to speak that way about such distinguished people...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sigh. Very well. Speak. If all you need is someone to listen, I will. We have plenty of time.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Time? Maybe I do, but yours doesn't seem endless, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's all right... As long as I don't choose to prepare for my departure...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text:
I always think this, Medea: you're a child, but
you talk like an old woman.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's all right. I'm still younger than you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What's that supposed to mean, Medea? Think you're special just because you're younger and taller?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That was not what I meant...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sigh. I shouldn't have let you into the village... You've frightened the villagers again.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That little lamb over there has a pen and paper ready, and her eyes are sparkling♡

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (Startles.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sigh... I'll listen to you, so please give Merimel your autograph.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Deal♡
(Shynic spends a long time telling Medea about her memories with Edda and the tangled emotions she feels now.)
(Talking seems to ease her heart. The shadow over Shynic's face lifts, and she looks more at peace.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thank you for listening...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad it helped. I hope that was all you needed. Please go home now.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You're so cold. Oh, well.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, I intend to strengthen the barrier that reacts specifically to you. Consider yourself warned.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You do realize I could break through it if I wanted, don't you?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sigh... Yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I suddenly find myself wanting your opinion. All the other Champions have shared their power with the adventurer, but I haven't yet. What do you think?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's your choice, Medea. Do what you want.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. My choice...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: My choice, for which the time has not yet come... Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (A faint smile touches Medea's lips. Shynic seems to understand its meaning.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll be off, then... I'll come again, so take care♡ Don't die, all right? Cough, cough...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All right. I won't die.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: W-wait! What do you mean, you'll come again...?!
